name: awesome-billing
what_it_holds: Large (1.3k star) curated awesome-list on billing/payments/pricing knowledge for platforms; general SaaS pricing, not travel/STR specific. Listed here only because it surfaced under the 'pricing-strategy' topic search; no STR/Airbnb content confirmed.
why_useful: Marginal — flagged only as a breadcrumb in case its pricing-strategy sub-sections link out to hospitality revenue-management resources; not independently verified to contain anything ABNB-relevant.
themes: Airbnb pricing tools and dynamic-pricing repos that embed market data (PriceLabs, Beyond, Wheelhouse style; open-source STR pricing with comps)

name: FAHADPN/Hotel-search-API
what_it_holds: Small utility generating Kayak.co.in redirect/search-result links for hotel queries; not a scraper of structured data, just a URL-builder.
why_useful: Negligible research value -- flagged only for completeness; does not extract or store any pricing/availability data itself.
themes: Expedia and Hotels.com datasets (Expedia hotel recommendation Kaggle, personalized ranking ICDM 2013, Expedia scrapers), Trivago RecSys 2019, Kayak/Skyscanner scrapers
why_all: Negligible research value -- flagged only for completeness; does not extract or store any pricing/availability data itself.

name: factden/reports
what_it_holds: Repo advertised as providing free sample datasets from FactDen's scrapers, but the only file actually present is `saas-battlecard-atlas-2026-sample.csv` (a sample from 50,000 G2.com software reviews, 30+ columns) -- no TripAdvisor, Airbnb, Booking, or Hotels.com sample data despite the org maintaining scrapers for all of them.
why_useful: Checked because it looked promising (a committed sample-data repo from an org with 20+ scrapers) but turned out irrelevant to travel/lodging. Flagging so nobody re-checks it expecting travel data.
license: stated 'public G2 review data provided for evaluation purposes'
themes: TripAdvisor datasets: hotel/vacation-rental reviews, review velocity, TripAdvisor rentals, scraper repos
why_all: Checked because it looked promising (a committed sample-data repo from an org with 20+ scrapers) but turned out irrelevant to travel/lodging. Flagging so nobody re-checks it expecting travel data.

name: vilano101-tax-filing
what_it_holds: Monthly Florida DR-15 (state sales/use tax) and St. Johns County tourist development tax filing records for a single named short-term-rental portfolio ("VILANO101"). Updated as recently as 9 Sep 2026.
why_useful: Real, current, granular Florida TDT filing data, but scoped to one operator's few properties in one county — not a market-wide series, so its value is illustrative of filing mechanics rather than a usable demand proxy.
themes: State and city hotel occupancy and lodging-tax datasets (Nevada, Florida tourist development tax, Texas hotel occupancy tax, California TOT, NYC hotel occupancy tax, Hawaii TAT)
why_all: Real, current, granular Florida TDT filing data, but scoped to one operator's few properties in one county — not a market-wide series, so its value is illustrative of filing mechanics rather than a usable demand proxy.

name: eurostat/Nuts2json
what_it_holds: Eurostat NUTS regional boundary dataset as JSON/TopoJSON for web mapping, 89 stars, active (updated 2026-09-11), EUPL-1.2.
why_useful: Not tourism data itself, but the NUTS2/NUTS3 geometry needed to join Eurostat tour_occ regional tables (published at NUTS2) to a map or to other geospatial STR/regulation datasets; low direct value but a useful joining key.
themes: European tourism statistics tooling: Eurostat tour_occ / tour_ce clients, INE Spain Frontur Egatur EOAT tourist-apartment tables, ISTAT, INSEE, Destatis, ONS travel, Portugal INE
why_all: Not tourism data itself, but the NUTS2/NUTS3 geometry needed to join Eurostat tour_occ regional tables (published at NUTS2) to a map or to other geospatial STR/regulation datasets; low direct value but a useful joining key.
